To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed new methods to assess risks of integrated GNSS/LIDAR navigation systems for HAV applications.

we developed an integrity and continuity risk assessment for GNSS/LiDAr navigation systems and that the integrity risk bound for unwanted object detection in GNSS/LIDAR navigation can be reduced from 10-5 to 10-7 with a 10% increase in the probability of continuity loss.

the proposed UO detection algorithm is able to detect unwanted objects with high accuracy and that the UO detection algorithm improves the integrity and continuity of the GNSS/Li-DAR-based navigation system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
improving navigation safety by detecting unwanted objects in the GNSS/LiLADR navigation system.
the development of a new integrity risk assessment algorithm for GNSS/LiADR navigation that is applicable for HAV applications.
the development of a new approach to integrity monitoring of GNSS/LiLADAR integrated navigation systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper provides a new approach to unwanted-object detection in GNSS/Lidar based navigation.
the integrity risk of a GNSS/LiLAD navigation solution for HAV is reduced by monitoring UO.
the proposed UO monitoring algorithm is a significant step forward in assessing safety risk of GNSS/LiLADR-based navigation systems for HAVs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed UO detection and risk prediction algorithm can be applied to any integrated navigation system that uses feature extraction.
we are able to quantify the impact of UO on the integrity and continuity of a GNSS/Li-DAR system.
we developed a new approach to unwanted object detection for integrated GNSS/LIDAR navigation systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
UO monitoring can be incorporated into the existing GNSS/LiDRAR navigation system to provide a more robust navigation system.
UO monitoring can significantly improve integrity and continuity of a GNSS/LiLAD navigation solution.
integrity and continuity risks can be mitigated by using UO detection to improve FE and DA performance, even in the presence of GNSS outages.
